''Medicago recta'' (Desf.) Willd. }} '''''Medicago minima''''' is a plant species of the genus ''[[Medicago]]''. It is native to the Mediterranean basin but is found worldwide.[http://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/cgi-bin/get_JM_treatment.pl?3691,4139,4142 Jepson Manual Treatment] It forms a [[symbiosis|symbiotic]] relationship with the bacterium ''[[Sinorhizobium meliloti]]'',{{Citation needed|date=September 2009}} which is capable of [[nitrogen fixation]]. Common names include '''bur medick''', '''little bur-clover''', '''little bur medick''', '''little medick''', '''small medick''', and '''woolly bur medick'''. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.ildis.org/LegumeWeb/6.00/taxa/5799.shtml International Legume Database & Information Services] {{Taxonbar|from=Q144139}} [[Category:Medicago|minima]] [[Category:Flora of Lebanon]] [[Category:Flora of Malta]] {{Trifolieae-stub}}
